name: zmodel_const_set_normalized_cross_from_vertex_triplet
description: zModel_Const::SetNormalizedCrossFromVertexTriplet computes the normalized cross product used by colinear vertex cleanup and zeros degenerate results.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the zModel polygon/source-cluster pass because x87 scheduling and caller context are likely significant.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482c60 validates the fastcall ABI with vertex0 in ecx, vertex1 in edx, outNormal and vertex2 on the stack, returning outNormal in eax.

Binary Ninja assembly validates the cross-product components from (vertex0 - vertex1) and (vertex2 - vertex1), the per-axis g_zModel_ColinearTolerance guard, magnitude normalization, and zero-scale degenerate path.
The native smoke verifies the returned outNormal pointer, normalized orientation for a right-angle triplet, and zeroing for a below-tolerance triplet.
